nom: Garnier SkinActive Charcoal Blackhead Eliminating Scrub

avis.texte: Garnier SkinActive Charcoal Scrub for oily acne prone skin. Guaranteed to help remove blackheads, whiteheads & red skin.

avis.titre: A charcoal facial scrub that does not disappoint!!!
avis.texte: This is the only charcoal facial scrub I have found that does not dry out or irritate my skin. My local WalMart & Target stores stopped selling it a few years ago so I was happy to find it at Amazon now.

I’ve been using this product and buying it from a local grocery store for longer than I can remember. When they stopped carrying it I, like a dummy, tried several other products. When told they weren’t going to restock it after a massive remodel, I finally snapped and thought to look for it on Amazon. Why didn’t I think of it before! Now, I buy three bottles at a time. And will buy more if I ever find out it might get discontinued. Have tried hundreds of face soaps over my oily life. This is the one I stick with!

avis.titre: It works, just not right for me.
avis.texte: I gave it time but I wasn’t too fond of this face wash, yes it worked but it made my skin feel dry and it left a soft feeling after using, I didn’t feel like it exfoliated my skin the way I’d like it too.

avis.titre: Ok for the price if it's on sale
avis.texte: Seems to have made my face breakout more than one I was using before this, hoping my face just need to get used to it
This scrub cleans my face amazingly well. Leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth without irritation. A little goes a long way, and it works great as part of a regular routine.
Trying this out at the moment. I think is a good product! I prefer these over st Ives scrub. The St Ives is too rough for the skin. This Gardnier scrub SOOOOOO smooth and what a difference
Refreshing!! I've been using it for about a week now during my night time routine- Feel super nice and cooling!! Just watch out using it near the eyes!

avis.titre: Beat facewash I've ever used (from a guy)
avis.texte: Hands down the best facewash I've ever used. My face has never been more noticibly clear and smooth and it basically worked instantly. Out of this world product. Buy it in the store though it is cheaper.

We've researched how beneficial charcoal can be for a beauty routine, so we looked forward to trying this Garnier SkinActive Charcoal Blackhead Acne Treatment Scrub. My aspiring actress/model daughter uses a charcoal toothpaste for whitening at the recommendation of other professionals in her field, and with great results. I wasn't sure what to expect from this face scrub; it is a clear, thin gel and sparsely contains charcoal "micro-beads" that makes the cleanser a little gritty. It has a nice clean scent, nothing overpowering. It states: "After One Use: Unclogs pores and smooths skin" -- my daughter only used this on/around her nose and really did see instant mattifying results from her first use (as you can kind of see in the pictures, it was hard to capture!) She sometimes gets the oily/spotty "Strawberry Nose" blackheads, and this worked impressively quick to combat that. She has pretty sensitive skin, and this did not cause any redness or irritation, which sometimes happens with other products containing Salicylic Acid. Directions are simple: "Apply the face wash and massage gently, avoiding contact with eyes. Rinse face thoroughly." -- a little bit was all that was necessary for her nose, so this product should last awhile. She rubbed it in, and let it sit on her skin for a few minutes, before washing off with warm water, and following up with her usual cleanser/Mia routine. I'm not sure if she'll use this daily, or only as-needed to get the results. The price is fanta
Skincare does not need fragrance. Why does this have fragrance in it? Fragrance in skincare can cause irritation and acne, and damages the skin barrier, especially to those with sensitive skin.

I'm a sucker for new skin care especially when I complete a bottle but lately I've been in search of a face mask.. This was pretty perfect! I have oily skin on top of Florida humidity which is a recipe for disaster at any age (I'm almost 29) and so far, day one after a mask and I woke up to noticeable softness with no excess oils! It's the first time in, well, probably since I was a child! this and the neutrageona hydroboost are my new regimes and will be for quite some time! Also, for the people complaining of redness-that's why they tell you to skin test. That is an allergy/you have ultra sensitive skin so stop using it?

I loved garnier because ever since, this is the one im using however im really disappointed when I got to received the item. There is no cap and it was so messed up. I even not sure if this is still safe to use. I guessed my money was put to waste.

Currently I'm miserable because this scrub has the microbeads from hell. This is the millionth time it's happened and yet I still use it because of the results I was getting. But one of those little suckers gets in my eye and it's near to impossible to get it out. It doesn't wash out and all you can do is sit here and feel it moving from one side of your eye to the other with no relief. I get in the shower to wash it out and nothing. I put my head under the sink and nothing. I rub it until my eye is raw and nothing. I don't care about the great results enough to be this miserable. The chances of you getting a microbead in your eye are highly likely so if you don't care about the stabbing pain then use it.

I was having high expectations when I bought this scrub without even knowing all the mess that was gonna bring to my face. I started it using it every night and after a couple of days of trying it I started getting this huge black patches around my mouth and chin. This is the worst thing that has ever happened to my skin. So disappointed. First picture is how my skin got after just a few days of using this scrub, and the second one is from today, I still can't get all the discoloration off all together.
